store_config_without_group: store a Hydra config dataclass in ConfigStore without assigning it to any group
store_config_with_unicode: store a Hydra config dataclass containing unicode characters in ConfigStore
store_config_in_group: store a Hydra config dataclass under a named group like dataset or optimizer in ConfigStore
store_config_with_package_override: store a Hydra config in ConfigStore with explicit package override such as _global_ or _group_
store_config_with_defaults_list: store a Hydra config in ConfigStore that includes a defaults list for composing other configs
